messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Threshold breach: streaming.gateway.p95 latency = 1.25s (5m window) in eu-west. Trace rate up, chunking stalls observed. Paging oncall.
sre-oncall: oncall here, seeing same SLO spike. Root traces show long write waits on proxy -> client. Starting triage.
carol (eng-runtime): looking at traces — many sessions stuck in SSE chunk flush for 10-30s. backlog on proxy egress buffers.
mike (eng-sre): can we confirm client slow-consumer rate? metrics show slow_consumer_count +40% over baseline.
laura (support): CS ping: two enterprise customers reported sessions timed out and reconnects. Likely UX impact. Clients: Acme and MaplePay.
josh (eng-platform): is this proxy keepalive / write timeout related? Configs were sticky after last deploy.
dana (oncall): I’ll run quick mitigation: start evict of clients with >5s write latency and mark for throttling. Executing command: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/evict?age=5s&reason=slow_consumer`
carol (eng-runtime): good. Also enable temporary slower-path: disable long-poll batching for streaming routes to reduce head-of-line delay (flip feature-flag). Patch pushed to canary.
k8s-deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/flag-disable-stream-batch -> canary eu-west-1 (pods: runtime-5 -> runtime-6).
mike (eng-sre): increasing proxy write timeout from 30s -> 60s as short-term, to avoid client drop churn. Applying config now.
josh (eng-platform): routing policy: divert 10% traffic to fallback lighter model variant to reduce token churn on busy sessions. Rolling out at LB.
laura (support): informing affected customers: MaplePay sees ~12% reconnects, Acme ~7%. Save logs and timelines for postmortem.
sre-oncall: monitoring p95/p99 — initial drop in p95 to 650ms after evict + flag, but p99 still elevated ~2.1s.
carol (eng-runtime): p99 dominated by specific client IP ranges repeatedly stalling. Adding aggressive per-connection write buffer limits and enabling backpressure metrics.
dana (oncall): I've throttled large uploads and kicked a couple of noisy IPs. Noticed proxy file descriptor exhaustion warning earlier — freeing connections.
mike (eng-sre): fd pool increase applied; will watch for saturation. Also enabling additional proxy worker on the cluster.
laura (support): customers acknowledged mitigation, want timeline and ETA. We should estimate time to steady-state: 15-20m.
sre-oncall: agree — will keep paging open. If p99 not <1.5s in 20m escalate to eng-runtime lead.
carol (eng-runtime): collecting heap and netstats from affected pods; saving traces to /incidents/6161616161/traces.
josh (eng-platform): documented rollback plan if canary worsens: revert flag and restore previous proxy config.
incident-bot: ticket created: INC-2026-6161616161. Annotated with mitigation steps.
sre-oncall: status update in 10m, keeping channel open. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
